notes: Dev panel pages for player, skills, statuses and reactions, run tools, debug drawing and an animation viewer.
On-screen display: crosshair, skills with cooldowns, health, and status icons above enemies.
Spell effects now play: sprite effects for hits, reactions, swaps and dodges.
The player now animates: legs follow movement, casting plays on the upper body, aim tilts the spine.
Twelve starting skills (three per element) and the water, earth, fire and wind combo.
Damage now follows weaknesses, resistances, rocked and guard before it triggers reactions.
Reactions between elements now work: steam, mud, shock chain, magma and the rest.
Burning, soaked, rocked and gusted now work and burning spreads.
Swapping elements, the swap-in bonus, and casting from the mouse buttons.
Skills can now be cast: projectiles, cones, streams, zones, walls, dashes and self buffs.
The player now moves, slides along walls and dodges.
Aiming, the third-person camera and keyboard and mouse input.
Dev panel with a performance page and tuning toolbar.
Data layers and patch validation for tuning values.
The forest clearing: pieces, generated colliders and boundary walls, drawn in the scene.
Chunky render profile and the first scene, with a browser smoke test.
Asset manifest, licence check and asset loader.
Simulation bridge with a worker, and a cap on catch-up after a backgrounded tab.
Simulation core: fixed 60 Hz tick, entities, events, snapshots and a state hash.
Game data schema, loader and validation, with the first data files.
Vector maths and world collision (rays, sweeps, ground).
Seeded random streams for the simulation.
Project started: design spec, build plan and the first converted assets.
